# NEEC: Normative Economic Evaluation Criteria

> NEEC compares economic systems against one fixed set of 29 normative criteria in five domains. Each criterion is scored 1.0, 0.5 or 0.0, clause by clause against its Pass Threshold; a 0.0 is a structural failure, and a system's tier depends only on its number of structural failures (0 to 2 Potentially Adequate, 3 to 5 Partially Adequate, 6 or more Structurally Inadequate). Version 2.0 scores are being finalized and are not shown on the site yet; the repository's neec_corpus.json holds the published provisional scores on the earlier 26-criterion structure. Authors: Duke Johnson and Claude (Anthropic). Duke Johnson designed CCO-PTF-CIP-SZH, one of the scored systems. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

## Start here

- [Site data (JSON)](https://bettertobest.github.io/NormativeEvaluation/data/neec.json): the criteria, systems, tiers, weighting schemes and recorded judgment calls, in one file
- [Criteria (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BetterToBest/NormativeEvaluation/main/criteria.json): every criterion's Pass Threshold, clauses and scoring anchors
- [Scoring protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BetterToBest/NormativeEvaluation/main/SCORING_PROTOCOL.md): how each criterion is scored; section 13 records every methodological decision
- [Prompt for checking a score](https://bettertobest.github.io/NormativeEvaluation/neec-ai-prompt-audit.md), and [for scoring blind](https://bettertobest.github.io/NormativeEvaluation/neec-ai-prompt-blind.md)
- [How to report a divergence or an error](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BetterToBest/NormativeEvaluation/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
